plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/23656
Vendor (TPA) is the primary victim; NC Office of State Human Resources (NCFlex) is the secondary victim. Website breach -> hacking Unknown via Web application, asset S - Web application. The mid-May 'infrastructure disruption' is not coded as part of this incident (relationship unclear). Data victim Customer (plan participants). Count not disclosed. Employee count 101 to 1000 (approximate).

summary: P&A Group, a third-party administrator of flexible spending accounts for North Carolina's NCFlex program, had a confirmed website security breach in late June 2026, after an earlier infrastructure disruption in mid-May. Social Security numbers, health account data and banking details of NCFlex participants were exposed. The North Carolina Office of State Human Resources told state employees not to use P&A accounts while the investigation continued.

victim_id: North Carolina Office of State Human Resources (NCFlex)
